notes: Curation metadata and editorial search aliases do not modify the registry or past observations. Korean aliases are editorial transliterations for search, not a claim that the publisher uses those names.

Official web pages were reviewed on the stated date. Some XML and legacy bindings require the separately recorded bounded endpoint check; identity evidence must not be presented as a reachability check.
Whole-publisher scope means a publisher-wide selection, not a guarantee of every published article. Sections, language editions, regional coverage and unresolved national-major gaps are explicit.

description.en: Six US-registered publisher selections for English business monitoring, mixing business-focused publishers with explicitly labelled business sections of general newsrooms. Coverage can include international business.
description.ko: 미국 등록 매체 6곳의 영어 경제·비즈니스 시작 목록입니다. 경제 전문 매체와 종합 매체의 비즈니스 섹션을 구분하며, 국제 경제 기사도 포함할 수 있습니다.

selection_criteria: Use exact existing country and typed endpoint bindings; no new or reactivated registrations.
One entry per publisher brand; multiple sections must not inflate publisher counts.
Official publisher identity and endpoint-declaration evidence is distinguished from endpoint reachability.
Selections are starting points; a successful check does not guarantee complete coverage, content freshness, article access or republication rights.
Include business-focused publisher streams and explicitly labelled business sections; do not describe all selections as economy-only.

entries.name: The New York Times
entries.scope_description: Business section of a general newspaper; section selection, not all New York Times output.

evidence.claim: English RSS directory labels this selection Business.
Official publisher page declares this exact RSS address.

entries.name: Los Angeles Times

entries.name: CNBC
entries.scope_description: CNBC Top News: a publisher-wide selection from a business-focused newsroom; may include politics and other topics. It is not a dedicated economy-only feed.

evidence.claim: English homepage identifies CNBC as a business and financial news outlet.
Official RSS directory declares Top News with content ID 100003114 using a different search.cnbc.com path; exact registered legacy-path equivalence requires the separate endpoint check.

entries.name: Fortune
entries.scope_description: Publisher-wide Fortune selection, including business, finance, leadership and lifestyle; no claim of complete publisher output or business-only filtering.

evidence.claim: English business publisher; homepage includes finance, leadership and lifestyle.
The publisher-hosted RSS identifies Fortune and language en-US. Its atom:self points to a different Fortune feed path; no separate HTML declaration of the registered path was rediscovered.

entries.name: NBC News
entries.scope_description: Business section of the US general-news broadcaster; excludes its other sections.

evidence.claim: English-language NBC News business section identifies the selected subject.

Exact RSS address is an existing active registry binding on the publisher feed host. No current HTML declaration was rediscovered; identity and availability must be read from the separate endpoint observation.

gaps.reason: The active legacy Business binding uses feed ID 1003, while the reviewed official Business page declares ID 1006. Do not recommend or relabel the mismatched registered address as business.
Existing active RSS selections are World News and US News; no registered business-only RSS selection was identified for this pack. Sitewide sitemap alone does not establish business article coverage.

Registered sitemap selections are broader news or sitemap-index routes. Business-only article-stream coverage was not established, so these important publishers are not counted in this starter selection.
Despite a US registry grouping, this starter pack does not infer US publisher identity from that grouping. A UK/global business pack needs a separately verified country classification.

gaps.reason: Legacy rows have conflicting names, host versions and category labels (including an EN name on a Japanese category URL). This pack does not resolve those bindings by name alone.

The registered RSS is disabled; the active sitewide sitemap does not establish a usable article-level stream. Disabled endpoints are not reactivated by curation.
